equity_bridge.item: Equity investments at book (PTx Trimble 15% 209.1, Platform Science 32.5% 253.9, other)
equity_bridge.note: Q3-2026 10-Q balance sheet and Note 5. Added because equity-method income is stripped from the EBITDA margin path (matching-asset rule). Platform Science is carried at cost under the measurement alternative; private-company marks are not market tested.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: organic revenue growth (9% in 9M-2026, 7% in Q3-2026) and organic ARR growth (~10% guided for FY2026), decelerated; NOT equity CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-year CAGR (10.2%) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (2.6%) and EPS (2.6%) CAGRs. All three are distorted by portfolio change: the 2024 agriculture contribution to the AGCO JV (~1.7bn gain lifted equity, removed revenue) and the 2025 Mobility sale. The house default of equity CAGR is therefore not used; year-1 growth is anchored to current organic growth and guidance.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are FY2022->FY2025 and FY2020->FY2025. FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less cash-flow SBC; no interest strip because the company is in net debt): FY2020 532.2, FY2022 227.6, FY2025 214.4. Reported FCF CAGRs are +1.2% (3yr) and -10.1% (5yr), so the owner series is weaker on both windows: SBC rose from 83 to 147 (2.6% to 4.1% of revenue) while reported FCF fell. FY2025 FCF was depressed by tax paid on the agriculture gain and FY2022 by working capital, so neither endpoint is clean; TTM owner FCF of 640.6 is the better read of current run-rate.

scenario_narratives.base: Organic ARR growth, guided down to ~10% for FY2026, keeps decelerating toward 7-8% and total revenue grows 7% in year 1 fading to 3% by year 10, with Field Systems hardware (civil construction and geospatial, up 12% in product revenue in 9M-2026) normalising from a strong year. The company reaches its ~30% adjusted EBITDA target on its own definition, but this model charges ~2pp of recurring restructuring and acquisition costs and strips equity-method income, so the house margin starts at 27.2% and climbs to 31% as subscription mix rises from ~65% of revenue. SBC holds near 4% of revenue (it has risen from 2.6% in 2020, so no rapid decline is assumed). Cash tax ramps from 17.5% to 21% as the IP-transfer amortisation shelter runs off. Transportation & Logistics stays in the group.
scenario_narratives.bull: The Connect & Scale thesis works as management frames it: Trimble Connect AI and usage-based pricing (SketchUp hybrid licences, >150M of transaction revenue in Transportation) re-accelerate organic ARR to 11-13%, infrastructure, reshoring and data-centre construction keep Field Systems hardware growing, and revenue compounds 9% for several years. Incremental software margins take the house EBITDA margin to 33% as restructuring genuinely tapers and SBC drifts down to 3.5% of revenue. A sale of Transportation & Logistics at a fair price would be upside to this path and is not included. Internal-control remediation is completed without further filing delays.
scenario_narratives.bear: The Q3-2026 signal is the start of a trend, not a blip: organic ARR growth slides to mid single digits as Autodesk and Procore out-invest Trimble in construction software and AI lowers the barrier for cheaper workflow tools, while a non-residential construction and freight downturn plus tariff costs cut hardware revenue in year 2 (total growth 1%). Lower-cost mass-market GNSS compresses positioning hardware pricing. The house EBITDA margin dips to 25.5% and stalls at 27%, short of the 30% target once recurring restructuring is charged; SBC stays above 4% of revenue as the share price weakens; cash tax reaches 22% under Pillar Two. The Transportation & Logistics review ends without a sale, consistent with the 562M goodwill impairment already taken on that unit.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Trimble is valued as a single operating business on unlevered owner free cash flow: stock compensation is expensed in full (about 4% of revenue), the restructuring and deal costs the company excludes from adjusted EBITDA every year are charged as recurring, and the minority stakes in PTx Trimble and Platform Science are added at book while their income is removed from the flows. The result is a house margin about 2.5 points below the company's own adjusted EBITDA margin. Most of the value depends on whether recurring-revenue growth holds in the high single digits after the Q3-2026 guidance cut; the hardware cycle and the open review of Transportation & Logistics are the secondary swings.
key_risks_to_valuation: Organic ARR growth: each point of sustained revenue growth over the decade moves base value by several dollars a share; the Q3-2026 cut to ~10% is one data point in a deceleration that the base case assumes continues gently and the bear case assumes continues sharply.

Restructuring treatment: the 2.0pp recurring charge is a judgment. If restructuring really ends, base margins are ~2pp too low (bull); at the 9M-2026 run-rate of 3.3% of revenue they are ~1.3pp too high.

Cash tax: 9M-2026 cash taxes paid (55.7) were well under the non-GAAP provision (122.6). The model does not perpetuate that gap; if the IP-amortisation shelter lasts longer than assumed, early-year flows are understated.
Hardware cyclicality: product revenue grew 12% in 9M-2026 on civil construction and geospatial demand; a construction downturn would hit revenue and margin together.
Transportation & Logistics review: a sale, spin or no-deal outcome changes revenue mix, ARR composition and net debt; the 562M impairment suggests a sale price below carrying value.
Equity investments at book (608.4, about 2.6 per share): Platform Science is a private company carried at cost and PTx Trimble is controlled by AGCO; neither mark is market tested.

Trailing FCF base: TTM reported FCF of 798.3 is flattered by low cash taxes and FY2025 was depressed by one-off tax on the agriculture gain, so trailing FCF multiples are unreliable in both directions.
Internal controls: material weaknesses and late filings in 2024-2025; a recurrence would restrict capital-markets access and pressure the multiple.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular close); 52-week range 47.92-84.42
data_sources.financials: TRMB_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL, 100 periods); Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-10-02 (Extracted/TRMB_Quarterly_Q3-2027.txt: balance sheet lines 1040-1075, cash flow 1190-1232, non-GAAP reconciliation 2020-2100, repurchases Note 2, equity investments Note 5); Form 10-K for the year ended 2026-01-02 (Extracted/TRMB_Annual_FY2026.txt: adjusted EBITDA line 2280, SBC reconciliation 2234, cash flow 2543-2578)
data_sources.qualitative: TRMB_Analysis.json (2026-11-15): segment mix, FY2026 guidance, T&L strategic review, bull and bear points

inputs.share_count_basis: 229.6M shares issued and outstanding at 2026-10-02 (Q3-2026 10-Q balance sheet) plus 0.8M treasury-method dilution (Q3-2026 diluted 233.2M less basic 232.4M weighted average). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; charging both would double-count.
inputs.sbc_source: Company's own non-GAAP reconciliation line 'Stock-based compensation / deferred compensation', TTM to Q3-2026 = FY2025 151.5 + 9M-2026 121.1 - 9M-2025 114.9 = 157.7 (10-K FY2025 line 2234; Q3-2026 10-Q line 1928). Cash-flow add-back on the same TTM basis is 153.7 (146.5 + 118.3 - 111.1). Tax withholdings on net-share settlement run ~45/yr (44.9 in 9M-2026, equity statement) and are NOT added on top: the expense already charges the full grant value, and the withholding is the cash mechanism for part of it.
inputs.fiscal_year_end: Friday nearest 31 December (52/53-week year; FY2025 ended 2026-01-02)
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows. Risk-free ~4.3% (10-year UST), equity risk premium ~5.0%, beta ~1.25 (industrial-tech hybrid with construction and freight cyclicality) gives cost of equity ~10.5%. Debt is ~10% of capital at ~5.5% pre-tax (~4.5% after tax). WACC ~9.9%, rounded to 9.5% in recognition of the 65% recurring revenue mix. The same WACC is used in all three scenarios: risk is charged once, through the scenario weights.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: lease cost is already inside operating expense and therefore inside adjusted EBITDA. No lease liability in net debt and no separate lease line (lease_cost_pct_path omitted). One treatment only.
inputs.nci_treatment: No material non-controlling interest; none deducted.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (dcf-methods routing table row 1: operating company, tech/industrial software and positioning hardware). First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry and no prior DCF. US filer, USD statements and USD quote, so the non-US adaptations file was not needed; the one adaptation applied is the matching-asset rule for equity investments (below). BASE: revenue base is the trailing twelve months to 2026-10-02 (FY2025 3,587.3 + 9M-2026 2,878.7 - 9M-2025 2,617.5 = 3,848.5) so that the flows start where the balance sheet stops; forecast year 1 is therefore the four quarters to Q3-2027, not calendar FY2027. FY2026 guidance (revenue 3,910-3,940, i.e. Q4 up ~8% year on year) is inside year 1. FILE LABELS: the Extracted filenames are one fiscal year late (TRMB_Annual_FY2026.txt is the year ended 2026-01-02 = Trimble FY2025; TRMB_Quarterly_Q3-2027.txt is the quarter ended 2026-10-02 = Q3-2026). The Metrics CSV period labels are correct. OWNER FCF: reported TTM FCF 798.3 = FY2025 360.9 + 9M-2026 643.6 (OCF 664.7 less capex 21.1) - 9M-2025 206.2. It is a LEVERED figure (after ~80 of interest paid) and is flattered by low cash taxes (55.7 paid in 9M-2026 against a 122.6 non-GAAP provision), while FY2025 was depressed by tax paid on the 2024 agriculture-JV gain; neither year is a clean base, which is why the forward flows are built from components rather than from last_fcf. Interest income is not stripped: the company is in net debt. EBITDA DEFINITION: the margin path is company adjusted EBITDA (FY2025 29.2%, 9M-2026 28.3%, ~30% targeted for FY2026) less two things: (1) ~0.4pp of equity-method income, which is removed from the flows because the investments are added at book in the equity bridge instead; (2) ~2.0pp for restructuring and acquisition/divestiture costs, which the company excludes every year but which have run 2.0% of revenue in FY2025, 3.1% in FY2024 and 3.3% in 9M-2026 and are treated here as a recurring cash cost. D&A: da_pct is depreciation plus cloud-computing amortisation only (48.8 in FY2025, ~1.25% of revenue). Purchased-intangible amortisation (~175/yr) is deliberately left out of the tax shield because the 17.3% non-GAAP tax rate the cash-tax path is anchored to is quoted on pre-amortisation income. CASH TAX: path ramps 17.5% -> 21% because part of the current low rate comes from tax amortisation on a non-US intercompany IP transfer, a shelter that runs off, plus Pillar Two. WORKING CAPITAL: deferred revenue (920) roughly offsets year-end receivables and inventory, so growth is close to cash-neutral; a small positive capture is used in base and bull, zero in bear. BUYBACKS: 552.9 of cash repurchases in 9M-2026 (8.7M shares at an average 63.40) against 157.7 of SBC, so the flat count is more than funded; a new 1.0bn authorisation was approved 2026-08-10 with 768.3 remaining. Buybacks beyond the SBC offset are debt- and FCF-funded capital return and are value-neutral here. GOODWILL: the 562.0 Q2-2026 impairment on the Transportation & Logistics unit is non-cash and non-deductible and does not enter the flows. T&L STRATEGIC REVIEW: the business is valued consolidated; a sale would swap ~15% of revenue for cash and is not modelled. ACQUISITIONS: growth paths are organic; tuck-in M&A (Document Crunch, 236.5 in Q2-2026) is neither in capex nor in growth. CONTEXT SCRIPT: make dcf-context printed the price and then failed opening TRMB.duckdb (DuckDB storage-version mismatch), so history was read from TRMB_Metrics.csv and the component lines directly from the 10-K and 10-Q text.

bear.narrative: Construction and freight downturn hits hardware in year 2 while ARR growth slides to mid single digits; margins stall below the 30% target.

base.narrative: ARR growth settles at high single digits; margin gains come from software mix, with restructuring charged as recurring.

bull.narrative: ARR re-accelerates to low double digits on AI and usage pricing; restructuring fades; margins reach the low 30s.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved off the 15/50/35 house default. Bear raised to 25%: organic ARR growth guidance was cut at Q3-2026, the T&L goodwill was impaired by 562M in Q2-2026, roughly 35% of revenue is still cyclical hardware and services tied to construction and freight, and the 2024-2025 material weaknesses and late filings are a governance risk that could recur; there is no refinancing or solvency risk (net debt ~1.3x house EBITDA), which is why it is not higher. Base held at 50%: it follows current organic growth and guidance with restructuring charged. Bull cut to 25%: it needs ARR re-acceleration, continued hardware strength and a genuine end to restructuring charges at the same time, three things that are not obviously correlated.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
